documents.description: Annexure-1 Letter of Bid committing to 90 days validity & Annexure-6 Technical Bid Form with comprehensive bidder profile and checklist.
RoC Certificate of Incorporation, Delhi Office Proof, PAN Card, GSTIN Registration (with trade name variation), EPF, ESIC, and Delhi Labour License.
CA Turnover Certificate with UDIN certifying 3-year average of Rs. 5.06 Cr + Audited P&L showing FY 2019-20 operational revenue of Rs. 5.40 Cr.
Work Orders and Completion Certificates for Project 1 (CBDT, Rs. 3.82 Cr), Project 2 (DPIIT, Rs. 2.95 Cr), and Project 3 (SAIL, Rs. 1.90 Cr).
Annexure-7 (Terms Acceptance), Annexure-8 (Non-conviction/No relatives), Annexure-10 (Minimum Wages & Labour Compliance), ISO 9001:2015 Cert, and typing speed statement.
Original SBI Bank Guarantee for Rs. 35,73,639/- valid through 15.08.2021 in favour of PAO CAG.

intentional_findings.details: Legal name 'Aravind Integrated Solutions Private Limited' on Incorporation vs Trade Name 'Aravind Integrated Solutions Pvt. Ltd.' on GST and CA Certificate.
CA Certificate certifies FY 2019-20 turnover as Rs. 6,20,40,000/-, whereas Audited P&L reports Revenue from Operations as Rs. 5,40,25,000/- (Discrepancy: Rs. 80.15 Lakhs).
Tender requires 1 order of 80% (Rs. 5.71 Cr) OR 2 orders of 50% (Rs. 3.57 Cr) OR 3 orders of 40% (Rs. 2.85 Cr). Project 3 (SAIL) is only Rs. 1.90 Cr and lacks a formal final completion certificate.
Annexure-9 Notarized Affidavit for VVIP / Sensitive Area Experience (Clause 2(d)(ii)) was not uploaded in the package.
Annexure-5 specifies 15,000 key depressions/hour for clerical staff; bidder provides an in-house assertion without third-party skill certification or speed logs.
Synthetic GST/PAN/Udyam values are processed without claiming unauthenticated external government verification.
